# T2ROTF - ReXGlue Recompiled Project
#
# SDK boilerplate lives in generated/rexglue.cmake.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(T2ROTF LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# generated/rexglue.cmake (regenerated by codegen) wires codegen into the
# build via $<TARGET_FILE:rex::rexglue>. The nfsmw-nx SDK base predates that
# target, so provide it manually pointing at the host tool (rebuilt from the
# layered-VFS SDK, NOT the stock rexglue-release binary). Host only: a cross
# build (Switch) must NOT run codegen (the tool is a host program that cannot
# run there) and must instead consume the already-generated sources.
if(NOT TARGET rex::rexglue)
    add_executable(rex::rexglue IMPORTED)
    set_target_properties(rex::rexglue PROPERTIES
        # codegen_wrapper.cmd appends the flags the rexglue template omits
        # (--update_data_root for the TU patch, --max_file_size_bytes so the
        # 1.36 MB function 0x82B7E3A0 does not exceed the 1 MB default limit),
        # so they survive every codegen regeneration of rexglue.cmake.
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/codegen_wrapper.cmd")
endif()

include(generated/rexglue.cmake)

# Sources
set(T2ROTF_SOURCES
    src/main.cpp
    src/switch_stdio_lock_stubs.cpp
    # WMV3/WVC1 movies decoded natively with the SDK's FFmpeg instead of the
    # recompiled XDK decoder, which hangs at ~99 % CPU / 0 FPS on the Switch
    # (t2rotf_video_wmv3.cpp/.h = ASF parser + VC-1 decoder;
    #  t2rotf_video_nativo.cpp = REX_HOOK_RAW hooks on sub_8279C5B8/sub_827EB2E8).
    src/t2rotf_video_wmv3.cpp
    src/t2rotf_video_nativo.cpp
    # [T44] The GPU signal source Renut's take-over removed with the Xenos
    # graphics system: the 0x7FC80000 register window plus the per-refresh
    # dispatch of the guest's graphics interrupt callback. Presentation stays
    # with Renut (presenter() is null); this only feeds the guest's display side.
    src/t2rotf_gpu_signal.cpp
)

if(WIN32)
    add_executable(T2ROTF WIN32 ${T2ROTF_SOURCES})
else()
    add_executable(T2ROTF ${T2ROTF_SOURCES})
endif()

# Switch: deko3d (reNut) only, 2026-10-24. No GPU plugin and no NVK driver: the
# emulated Xenos GPU (PM4 ring + EDRAM over Vulkan) is a PC reference, and
# REXGLUE_SWITCH_NO_NVK in the SDK keeps libvulkan.a out of the NRO.
if(REXGLUE_PLATFORM_SWITCH)
    rexglue_setup_target(T2ROTF)
else()
    rexglue_setup_target(T2ROTF GPU_PLUGINS xenos)
endif()

# Switch: Renut's renderer (plume + deko3d) is this port's graphics path. The file
# builds t2_renut_gpu (an OBJECT library: its hooks replace the generated code's weak
# sub_X definitions) and links it into T2ROTF at its end.
if(REXGLUE_PLATFORM_SWITCH)
    include(cmake/t2_renut_gpu.cmake)
endif()

# The SDK's FFmpeg (WMV3/WVC1 decoder) for the movies: t2rotf_video_wmv3.cpp.
# libavcodec PUBLIC-depends on libavutil in the SDK, so linking it alone is enough.
target_link_libraries(T2ROTF PRIVATE libavcodec)

# Nintendo Switch: T2ROTF.nro next to the ELF. On the SD card it goes in
# sdmc:/switch/T2ROTF/ with the game_root/ folder extracted beside it
# (src/T2ROTF_app.h looks for it there).
if(REXGLUE_PLATFORM_SWITCH)
    # LTO on the game code and the app (not on the SDK libraries). 193 MB of
    # generated source; with more processes it does not fit in 16 GB, so the
    # whole-program phase runs with -flto=2 -flto-partition=balanced.
    option(T2ROTF_LTO "LTO en el codigo del juego y de la app (Switch)" ON)
    if(T2ROTF_LTO)
        foreach(objetivo T2ROTF_recomp T2ROTF)
            if(TARGET ${objetivo})
                target_compile_options(${objetivo} PRIVATE -flto -fno-fat-lto-objects)
            endif()
        endforeach()
        # -flto-partition=one: single lto-wrapper worker. balanced + many
        # workers deadlocks on Windows (wrapper waits on inherited pipe
        # handles for jobs that already exited); one is slower but reliable.
        target_link_options(T2ROTF PRIVATE -flto=2 -flto-partition=one)
    endif()
    # Homebrew menu icon: a 256x256 PNG, as elf2nro expects.
    set(T2ROTF_ICON "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../icon_T2.png")
    set(T2ROTF_ICON_ARG)
    if(EXISTS "${T2ROTF_ICON}")
        set(T2ROTF_ICON_ARG ICON "${T2ROTF_ICON}")
    endif()
    rexglue_switch_add_nro(T2ROTF
        NAME "Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen"
        AUTHOR "mzy1996"
        VERSION "0.1.0"
        ${T2ROTF_ICON_ARG})
endif()
